# Fixture: spotread 成功测量输出
# 来源: 手写，基于 ArgyllCMS spotread 实际输出格式
# 工具版本: ArgyllCMS v2.2.x / v3.x
# 命令: spotread -e -d l -c 1

# ========== 启动阶段 ==========
# 注意: stderr=subprocess.STDOUT，所有输出合并
ArgyllCMS spotread - Emissive (Display) measurement utility
Version 2.2.1

Setting up instrument ...
Found instrument 'hid:111 (i1 Display Pro, ColorMunki Display)'
Serial Number: XXXXXXXX
Using spectral sample file: /path/to/ArgyllCMS/ref/i1d3ss.ccss
Place instrument on measurement area ...
Hit any key to continue:

# ========== 测量阶段 ==========
# 用户发送换行符触发测量
# spotread 输出测量结果

Result is XYZ: 0.033364 0.029912 0.062078, D50 Lab: 12.34 -3.45 6.78

# ========== 退出阶段 ==========
# 用户发送 'q' 退出
Instrument can be removed from measurement area.

# ========== 预期解析结果 ==========
# 正则匹配: XYZ_PATTERN = r'Result is XYZ:\s*([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)'
# 提取值: X=0.033364, Y=0.029912, Z=0.062078
# 转换为 xyY:
#   x = X / (X+Y+Z) = 0.033364 / 0.125354 = 0.2662
#   y = Y / (X+Y+Z) = 0.029912 / 0.125354 = 0.2387
#   Y = 0.029912 (保持不变)
# 最终结果: (x=0.2662, y=0.2387, Y=0.029912)

# ========== 关键检测点 ==========
# - "Result is XYZ:" 表示测量成功
# - XYZ 值为空格分隔的三个浮点数
# - D50 Lab 值在 XYZ 之后，可选
# - "Instrument can be removed" 表示正常退出
